verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֥וֹת אֶת־ בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפֵ֖ץ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·wṯ šə·lō·mōh liḇ·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’êṯ kāl- ḥê·šeq šə·lō·mōh ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄êṣ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now when Solomon had finished building the house of the LORD and the royal palace and had achieved all that he had desired to do

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה שֵׁנִ֑ית כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִרְאָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā Yah·weh ’el- šə·lō·mōh šê·nîṯ ka·’ă·šer nir·’āh ’ê·lāw bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn
verses.literal: the LORD appeared to him a second time as He had appeared to him at Gibeon

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ תְּפִלָּתְךָ֣ וְאֶת־ תְּחִנָּתְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְחַנַּ֣נְתָּה לְפָנַי֒ הִקְדַּ֗שְׁתִּי אֶת־ הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנִ֔תָה לָשֽׂוּם־ שְׁמִ֥י שָׁ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧י וְלִבִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lāw šā·ma‘·tî ’eṯ- tə·p̄il·lā·ṯə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- tə·ḥin·nā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer hiṯ·ḥan·nan·tāh lə·p̄ā·nay hiq·daš·tî ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh ’ă·šer bā·ni·ṯāh lā·śūm- šə·mî šām ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·hā·yū ‘ê·nay wə·lib·bî šām kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: And the LORD said to him I have heard your prayer and petition - before Me I have consecrated this temple which you have built by putting My Name there forever . . . My eyes and My heart will be there for all time

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה אִם־ תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנַ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלַ֜ךְ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֙יךָ֙ בְּתָם־ לֵבָ֣ב וּבְיֹ֔שֶׁר לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑יךָ חֻקַּ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’im- tê·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·nay ka·’ă·šer hā·laḵ dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā bə·ṯām- lê·ḇāḇ ū·ḇə·yō·šer la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî·ḵā ḥuq·qay ū·miš·pā·ṭay tiš·mōr
verses.literal: And as for you if you walk before Me as your father David walked with a heart of integrity and uprightness doing all I have commanded you and if you keep My statutes and ordinances

verses.original: וַהֲקִ֨מֹתִ֜י אֶת־ כִּסֵּ֧א מַֽמְלַכְתְּךָ֛ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעֹלָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי עַל־ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מֵעַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- kis·sê mam·laḵ·tə·ḵā ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl lə·‘ō·lām ka·’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ‘al- dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā lê·mōr lō- yik·kā·rêṯ lə·ḵā ’îš mê·‘al kis·sê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever . . . as I promised your father David when I said You will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel

verses.original: אִם־ שׁ֨וֹב תְּשֻׁב֜וּן אַתֶּ֤ם וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְלֹ֤א תִשְׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣י חֻקֹּתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- šō·wḇ tə·šu·ḇūn ’at·tem ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem mê·’a·ḥă·ray wə·lō ṯiš·mə·rū miṣ·wō·ṯay ḥuq·qō·ṯay ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê·ḵem wa·hă·laḵ·tem wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî·ṯem lā·hem
verses.literal: But if indeed you or your sons turn away from following Me and do not keep the commandments and statutes I have set before you and if you go off to serve and worship other gods

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵעַ֨ל פְּנֵ֤י הָאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִשְׁמִ֔י אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמָשָׁ֥ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּכָל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem wə·’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer hiq·daš·tî liš·mî ’ă·šal·laḥ mê·‘al pā·nāy wə·hā·yāh yiś·rā·’êl lə·mā·šāl wə·liš·nî·nāh bə·ḵāl hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן כָּל־ עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו יִשֹּׁ֣ם וְשָׁרָ֑ק וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל־ מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְלַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh yih·yeh ‘el·yō·wn kāl- ‘ō·ḇêr ‘ā·lāw yiš·šōm wə·šā·rāq wə·’ā·mə·rū ‘al- meh ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh kā·ḵāh lā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ wə·lab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss and say Why . . . has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָזְב֜וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ אֲבֹתָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽיַּחֲזִ֙קוּ֙ בֵּאלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לָהֶ֖ם וַיַּעַבְדֻ֑ם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן הֵבִ֤יא יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָרָעָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū ‘al ’ă·šer ‘ā·zə·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ’ă·šer hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·ya·ḥă·zi·qū bê·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yiš·ta·ḥū lā·hem way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏum ‘al- kên hê·ḇî Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And others will answer Because they have forsaken the LORD their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt and have embraced other gods worshiping and serving them because of this the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י מִקְצֵה֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י הַבָּתִּ֑ים אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·ṣêh ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh ’ă·šer- bā·nāh šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- šə·nê hab·bāt·tîm ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Now at the end of the twenty years during which Solomon built these two houses the house of the LORD and the royal palace

verses.original: חִירָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֠ר נִשָּׂ֨א אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בַּעֲצֵי֩ אֲרָזִ֨ים וּבַעֲצֵ֧י בְרוֹשִׁ֛ים וּבַזָּהָ֖ב לְכָל־ חֶפְצ֑וֹ אָ֡ז יִתֵּן֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה לְחִירָם֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֔יר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגָּלִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ḥî·rām me·leḵ- ṣōr niś·śā ’eṯ- šə·lō·mōh ba·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm ū·ḇa·‘ă·ṣê ḇə·rō·wō·šîm ū·ḇaz·zā·hāḇ lə·ḵāl ḥep̄·ṣōw ’āz yit·tên ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh lə·ḥî·rām ‘eś·rîm ‘îr bə·’e·reṣ hag·gā·lîl
verses.literal: King Solomon gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre who had supplied him with cedar . . . and cypress logs and gold for his every desire

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א חִירָם֙ מִצֹּ֔ר לִרְאוֹת֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַן־ ל֖וֹ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְלֹ֥א יָשְׁר֖וּ בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ḥî·rām miṣ·ṣōr lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer nā·ṯan- lōw šə·lō·mōh wə·lō yā·šə·rū bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: So Hiram went out from Tyre to inspect the towns that Solomon had given him but he was not pleased with them

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תָּה לִּ֖י אָחִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כָּב֔וּל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tāh lî ’ā·ḥî way·yiq·rā lā·hem ’e·reṣ kā·ḇūl ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: What are these towns you have given me my brother asked Hiram and he called them the Land of Cabul as they are called to this day

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִירָ֖ם לַמֶּ֑לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥî·rām lam·me·leḵ mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm kik·kar zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: And Hiram had sent the king 120 . . . talents of gold

verses.original: וְזֶ֨ה דְבַר־ הַמַּ֜ס אֲשֶֽׁר־ הֶעֱלָ֣ה׀ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנוֹת֩ אֶת־ בֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֤ה וְאֶת־ בֵּיתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּלּ֔וֹא וְאֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת־ חָצֹ֥ר וְאֶת־ מְגִדּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ גָּֽזֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh ḏə·ḇar- ham·mas ’ă·šer- he·‘ĕ·lāh ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh liḇ·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- bê·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- ham·mil·lō·w wə·’êṯ ḥō·w·maṯ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- ḥā·ṣōr wə·’eṯ- mə·ḡid·dōw wə·’eṯ- gā·zer
verses.literal: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon imposed to build the house of the LORD his own palace the supporting terraces and the wall of Jerusalem as well as Hazor Megiddo and Gezer

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֨ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֜יִם עָלָ֗ה וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־ גֶּ֙זֶר֙ וַיִּשְׂרְפָ֣הּ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְאֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּעִ֖יר הָרָ֑ג וַֽיִּתְּנָהּ֙ שִׁלֻּחִ֔ים לְבִתּ֖וֹ אֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim ‘ā·lāh way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- ge·zer way·yiś·rə·p̄āh bā·’êš wə·’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hay·yō·šêḇ bā·‘îr hā·rāḡ way·yit·tə·nāh šil·lu·ḥîm lə·ḇit·tōw ’ê·šeṯ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer He had set it on fire killed the Canaanites who lived in the city and given it as a dowry to his daughter Solomon’s wife

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־ גָּ֔זֶר וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית חֹרֹ֖ן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- gā·zer wə·’eṯ- bêṯ ḥō·rōn taḥ·tō·wn
verses.literal: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer Lower Beth-horon

verses.original: וְאֶֽת־ בַּעֲלָ֛ת וְאֶת־ תָּמָר בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ba·‘ă·lāṯ wə·’eṯ- tå̄·må̄r bam·miḏ·bār bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Baalath and Tamar in the Wilderness of Judah

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ עָרֵ֤י הַֽמִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְאֵת֙ עָרֵ֣י הָרֶ֔כֶב וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַפָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת׀ חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִבְנ֤וֹת בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ וּבַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ā·rê ham·mis·kə·nō·wṯ ’ă·šer hā·yū liš·lō·mōh wə·’êṯ ‘ā·rê hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’êṯ ‘ā·rê hap·pā·rā·šîm wə·’êṯ ḥê·šeq šə·lō·mōh ’ă·šer ḥā·šaq liḇ·nō·wṯ bî·rū·šā·lim ū·ḇal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ū·ḇə·ḵōl ’e·reṣ mem·šal·tōw
verses.literal: as well as all the store cities that Solomon had for his chariots - and horses - whatever he desired . . . to build in Jerusalem Lebanon and throughout the land of his dominion

verses.original: כָּל־ הָ֠עָם הַנּוֹתָ֨ר מִן־ הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַחִתִּ֤י הַפְּרִזִּי֙ הַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·‘ām han·nō·w·ṯār min- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ha·ḥit·tî hap·pə·riz·zî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî ’ă·šer lō- mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh
verses.literal: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites Hittites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites the people who were not Israelites . . .

verses.original: בְּנֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יָכְל֛וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַֽחֲרִימָ֑ם וַיַּעֲלֵ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַס־ עֹבֵ֔ד עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê·hem ’ă·šer nō·ṯə·rū ’a·ḥă·rê·hem bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḵə·lū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ha·ḥă·rî·mām way·ya·‘ă·lêm šə·lō·mōh lə·mas- ‘ō·ḇêḏ ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: their descendants who remained in the land those whom the Israelites . . . were unable . . . to devote to destruction Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers as they are to this day

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא־ נָתַ֥ן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עָ֑בֶד כִּי־ הֵ֞ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַעֲבָדָיו֙ וְשָׂרָ֣יו וְשָׁלִשָׁ֔יו וְשָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖וֹ וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lō- nā·ṯan šə·lō·mōh ‘ā·ḇeḏ kî- hêm ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·śā·rāw wə·šā·li·šāw wə·śā·rê riḵ·bōw ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw
verses.literal: But Solomon did not consign any of the Israelites to slavery because they were his men of war his servants his officers his captains and the commanders of his chariots and cavalry

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ שָׂרֵ֣י הַנִּצָּבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל־ הַמְּלָאכָה֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת הָרֹדִ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם הָעֹשִׂ֖ים בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh śā·rê han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh liš·lō·mōh ḥă·miš·šîm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ hā·rō·ḏîm bā·‘ām hā·‘ō·śîm bam·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: They were also the chief officers over Solomon’s projects 550 . . . . . . supervisors over the people who did the work

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה עָֽלְתָה֙ מֵעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד אֶל־ בֵּיתָ֖הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה־ לָ֑הּ אָ֖ז בָּנָ֥ה אֶת־ הַמִּלּֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ baṯ- par·‘ōh ‘ā·lə·ṯāh mê·‘îr dā·wiḏ ’el- bê·ṯāh ’ă·šer bā·nāh- lāh ’āz bā·nāh ’eṯ- ham·mil·lō·w
verses.literal: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace that Solomon had built for her he built the supporting terraces

verses.original: וְהֶעֱלָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֡ה שָׁלֹשׁ֩ פְּעָמִ֨ים בַּשָּׁנָ֜ה עֹל֣וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֗ים עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֔ה וְהַקְטֵ֣יר אִתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֖ם אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh šə·lō·mōh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm baš·šā·nāh ‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·šə·lā·mîm ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer bā·nāh Yah·weh wə·haq·ṭêr ’it·tōw ’ă·šer lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·šil·lam ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD burning incense with them before the LORD So he completed the temple

verses.original: וָאֳנִ֡י עָשָׂה֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בְּעֶצְיֽוֹן־ גֶּ֨בֶר אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶת־ אֵל֛וֹת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת יַם־ ס֖וּף בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’o·nî ‘ā·śāh ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh bə·‘eṣ·yō·wn- ge·ḇer ’ă·šer ’eṯ- ’ê·lō·wṯ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ yam- sūp̄ bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: King Solomon also assembled a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber which is near Eloth in Edom on the shore of the Red Sea

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח חִירָ֤ם בָּֽאֳנִי֙ אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו אַנְשֵׁ֣י אֳנִיּ֔וֹת יֹדְעֵ֖י הַיָּ֑ם עִ֖ם עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥî·rām bā·’o·nî ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’an·šê ’o·nî·yō·wṯ yō·ḏə·‘ê hay·yām ‘im ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: And Hiram sent his servants sailors who knew the sea to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s servants

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אוֹפִ֔ירָה וַיִּקְח֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ זָהָ֔ב אַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים כִּכָּ֑ר וַיָּבִ֖אוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ō·w·p̄î·rāh way·yiq·ḥū miš·šām zā·hāḇ ’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·‘eś·rîm kik·kār way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’el- ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: They sailed to Ophir and imported gold from there 420 . . . . . . talents and delivered it to . . . Solomon
